author: Unreal Engine
description:
Big ideas. New tools. Endless possibilities. 

Epic Games’ Senior Director of R&D, Michael Lentine, joined us at our San Francisco MegaJam hub to share how new game development workflows are expanding what’s possible in a weekend and beyond.

Learn more: https://itch.io/jam/2026-epic-ai-megajam
title: Big Ideas. New Tools. Endless Possibilities. | Epic MegaJam 2026

author: Unreal Engine
description:
Join us as Joel Wang from Hyper3D shows how to turn a text prompt into a game-ready 3D asset for Unreal Engine using Rodin. He'll walk through generating a model, fitting it to a greybox, splitting it into parts, and refining the mesh, and show how to rig and animate both humanoid and quadruped characters using UE5-compatible skeletons.

For more information on the Epic AI MegaJam, click here: https://www.unrealengine.com/news/2026-epic-ai-megajam
https://itch.io/jam/2026-epic-ai-megajam
title: Epic AI MegaJam | Hyper3D
